scope: manual primary-source readiness review of three routing-pilot POIs

records.name: Центральный музей МЧС России
records.evidence_access: Official-page search index excerpt read; direct page fetch timed out and museum subdomain was unavailable to web tool
records.observation: Official excerpt describes Khimki/Novogorsk address, relocation and group advance-booking restrictions; Geoapify record points to central Moscow
records.action: Do not treat technical walking paths as proof of visitor access; original snapshot unchanged

records.name: Музей экслибриса и миниатюрной книги
records.observation: Official site lists weekday 10:00-17:00 and weekend closure; group excursion price cannot be used as a per-person ticket price
records.action: No hours, price, or duration copied into POI; future dated sidecar requires verified scope and exceptions

records.name: Московский дом художника
records.observation: Official site distinguishes shop hours from exhibition hours (12:00-19:00 daily); third-party hours cannot silently replace exhibition schedule
records.action: No price or duration inferred; select correct exhibition and applicable date before planning

limitations: Not an exhaustive factual audit of all 2058 POIs
No current availability is inferred solely from a website or search excerpt
No source content is scraped into a new production dataset
